subject: reasoning
question:
The seminar in Chandigarh was held 3 days before the Delhi seminar. The seminar in Lucknow was 2 days after the Chandigarh seminar.

If the Delhi seminar was on 10th March, when was the Lucknow seminar?
solution:
**Conditions:**

 
• Chandigarh seminar was held 3 days before Delhi.
 
• Lucknow seminar was 2 days after Chandigarh.
 
• Delhi seminar was on 10th March**.**

 Delhi = 10th March (given directly)
